page_topic_one_liner: AI CLI tools — natural language to shell commands and agentic terminal workflows
differentiator_vs_generic: Terminal window with NL prompt morphing into executed shell commands, NOT IDE code editor or browser chat.
visual_anchors: HERO (~50% canvas): Dark terminal panel — blurred natural-language prompt line at top, arrow into highlighted shell command block with cursor blink, file tree sidebar thumbnail
Agent step checklist ribbon: plan → run → verify icons with torn-paper connectors (blurred labels only)
2x2 grid of CLI task vignettes (deploy script, log grep, git commit, env setup) — terminal output fragments only
Magnifying glass zooming on one command flag and output line pair
anti_patterns: IDE code editor with inline completion hero
Generic chat bubbles without terminal chrome
